content:
We have mass spec: main peak m/z 224.120115. Likely molecular ion [M]+. So molecular weight ~224.12. IR shows strong around 1723 cm-1 (C=O). Also many aromatic C-H around 3000-3100. So likely aromatic ketone or ester. 1723 suggests carbonyl (maybe ketone, aldehyde, ester). Aromatic peaks many.

We need SMILES. Need more data: NMR would help. Let's get proton NMR.
